Hierarchical Trajectory Planning of Floating-Base Multi-Link Robot for Maneuvering in Confined Environments

item.description: We introduce NEO-Planner, which uses a neural network to initialize trajectory optimization for autonomous drones, cutting computation by 26% without sacrificing quality.
